text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt rewarding, but taking profits too quickly can leave too little invested for further gains; I should set sell rules based on my overall plan, not just a position being up.","I treated each stock as a separate account and focused on gains versus my purchase price. I should judge decisions by the portfolio’s future risk and return, not by whether a sale realizes a loss or gain.","Even with frequent trades and several profitable sales, my account value fell from Period 2 to Period 5. I should track overall performance, diversify thoughtfully, and avoid assuming that frequent trading improves results."]}
